definitions.contract_outcomes: One terminal outcome per source per run; not HTTP request count or independent measurements.
definitions.instrumented_response_body_bytes: Exact recorded response bodies, including failed attempts; excludes cached objects and HTTP headers.
definitions.known_response_body_bytes_lower_bound: Instrumented body bytes plus successful retained downloads from legacy runs lacking transfer metrics.
definitions.legacy_quarantined_outcome_bytes_not_tra: May include rejected downloads or conflicting cached objects; never added to the transfer estimate.
definitions.network_total: Unknown for legacy uninstrumented runs; prefix probes and other non-acquisition requests excluded.
definitions.raw_distinct_content_hashes: Deduplicated byte content across those retained paths.
definitions.raw_unique_path_hash_objects: Verified retained local paths and SHA256; copies at distinct paths count separately.
definitions.scope: All completed lane=paper acquisition receipts, including historical/cached attempts.
